headline: Trade {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points of persona consistency for {cost_per_1k.f64|usd} per 1,000 replies on {arm:f64}, or keep {arm:prod}.
lede: {arm:f64} cuts cost from {cost_per_1k.prod|usd} to {cost_per_1k.f64|usd} while clearing all guardrails, but drops character consistency from {judged.persona.prod|pct} to {judged.persona.f64|pct}. A choice depends on the business valuation of consistency points.

slots.text: {arm:f64} lowers cost by {cost_per_1k.f64|usd} per 1,000 replies against {cost_per_1k.prod|usd} on {arm:prod}, conceding {contrast.f64.persona.delta|abs|pts} points ({contrast.f64.persona.interval|pts}) on persona consistency.
If preserving one point of persona consistency is worth more than ten cents per 1,000 replies, {arm:prod} remains preferable.
Lean toward {arm:f64} if monthly volume warrants the cost reduction and human reviewers tolerate minor persona drift on long turns.
A live prompt routing test or human acceptance threshold on long conversations would confirm whether users detect the persona degradation.

method.text: Four arms evaluated across {scoreboard.prod.cases|int} cases with {scoreboard.prod.ran|int} total runs per arm.
Persona consistency assessed by a calibrated judge with {judged.persona.agreement} agreement on {judged.persona.calibration_ratings|int} ratings.
Ninety-five percent paired intervals computed against control, reported without multiple-comparison correction.
Music facts required at {criteria.facts.threshold|pct}; speculation refusal required at {criteria.specul.threshold|pct} on bait prompts.
Cost per 1,000 replies calculated from token consumption against standard list prices.
Reported via telemetry distributions across runs rather than formal comparative hypothesis testing.

flag.title: No target trade ratio set in advance
flag.text: The evaluation did not specify a pre-registered exchange rate between cost and character consistency, so leadership must price the tradeoff directly.
